## Summary

Describe the change and the user or maintainer problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Website or UI
- [ ] Catalog data
- [ ] Validation or tooling
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] GitHub Actions or deployment
- [ ] Security or maintenance

## Catalog-quality review

Complete this section for resource or data changes. Explain the country, discipline, resource type, first-party source, English-content evidence, public-access status, and deduplication check. Do not add mirrors, login-gated resources, paywalled content, cover pages, syllabi, administrative files, or documents without substantive questions or solutions.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `pnpm test`.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm check`.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm build`.
- [ ] I verified affected routes or workflows locally.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I checked responsive and keyboard-accessible behavior where UI changed.

## Documentation and safety

- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, credentials, private data, or unnecessary generated artifacts.
- [ ] I followed the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and read the [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md).
- [ ] My contribution is compatible with the repository’s MIT License and does not improperly redistribute restricted material.

## Screenshots or logs

Add screenshots, links, or concise logs when they help reviewers understand the change. Redact secrets and personal information.

## Additional notes

Include migration notes, known limitations, follow-up work, or attribution details.
